name: claude-code-usage-pie
description: Monitor Claude Code usage in VS Code with Unicode pie indicators in the status bar

commands.title: Claude Code Usage Pie: Refresh Claude Usage
Claude Code Usage Pie: Login to Claude

claudeCodeUsagePie.updateInterval.description: How often usage is refreshed, in seconds.

claudeCodeUsagePie.showNotifications.description: Show warnings when usage exceeds the threshold.

claudeCodeUsagePie.warningThreshold.description: Usage percentage that triggers a warning.

claudeCodeUsagePie.usageDataSource.description: Where usage comes from: local JSONL first with API calibration, or API only.

claudeCodeUsagePie.apiSyncIntervalMinute.description: How often API calibration runs when local-first mode is enabled, in minutes.

claudeCodeUsagePie.disableApiSync.description: Disable all API calls. Use local JSONL parsing only (no authentication errors or API noise).

claudeCodeUsagePie.localFiveHourLimit.description: Fallback 5-hour token limit used in local mode when API limits are unavailable.

claudeCodeUsagePie.localSevenDayLimit.description: Fallback 7-day token limit used in local mode when API limits are unavailable.

claudeCodeUsagePie.localSevenDayOpusLimi.description: Fallback 7-day Opus token limit used in local mode when API limits are unavailable.

claudeCodeUsagePie.statusBarTemplate.description: Status bar text template. Supported placeholders: {pie}, {perc}, {percent}. Example pie-only: {pie}.

claudeCodeUsagePie.statusBarSymbols.description: Symbols for usage progression from 0% to 100%. First item is 0%, last item is 100%.

claudeCodeUsagePie.weeklyResetDay.description: Day of the week when the 7-day usage window resets. Set to 'rolling' for a standard rolling 7-day window.

claudeCodeUsagePie.weeklyResetHour.description: Hour of day (0-23, local time) when the weekly usage window resets. Only applies when weeklyResetDay is not 'rolling'.

claudeCodeUsagePie.weeklyStatusBarSymbol.description: Optional symbols for weekly (7-day) usage in the status bar. Use {weekPie} in statusBarTemplate to display it. Falls back to statusBarSymbols if empty.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
